title.narrative: Strengthening Public Sector Internal Audit IDF

description.narrative: The Republic of Armenia has taken many positive steps to improve internal audit in the government sector with significant assistance and support provided by the World Bank. Particularly, the legal framework, internal audit standards, internal audit and training manuals have been successfully developed under the WB funded IDF grant on Public Sector Internal Audit (TF 052687). The majority of the activities under the grant have been completed with training and awareness workshops to be implemented within next 2-3 months. The reforms in the internal audit remain one of the key priorities of the Armenian Government. In addition, the Internal Audit was assessed as one of the weakest PFM elements according to the recent PEFA assessment report (October 2008). In order to advance the reforms initiated under the Bank's initial IDF grant and complete the design of the internal audit system the current project will help to scale up the reforms through the following activities: (1) Before introduction of the new internal audit framework, broader scale piloting of the internal audit methodology in the government system will be conducted (Ministry of Finance, government agencies and committees, municipal and rural communities and non-commercial organization) to test the various environments in the operation of the designed system, (2) Procurement of the equipment (mainly notebooks) for government employees involved in running pilots, (3) Update the legislative framework as a result of wider scale piloting of the new system, (4) Development of the detailed implementation plan for the new system, (5) Training of trainers for further knowledge building in the public internal audit profession, (6) Development and implementation of the unified internal audit information management system, which is going to be a tool to enforce the standards and methodology developed. This project will be built up on the initial IDF grant and will ensure continuity in the initial stage of the challenging reform in this critical PFM area. TF093846 The objective of the Grant is to strengthen the institutional framework and build the capacity of the public sector internal audit in Armenia.
